title: Abba Chilkiyah of Karuyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Maaser Sheni 4:3, saying: “At first they used to do,” etc. Zuckermandel’s Tosefta reads Abba Chilfa of Karuya.[^1]

notes.text: The returned Tosefta Maaser Sheni 4:3 names Abba Chilkiyah of Karuyah. The different reading ascribed to Zuckermandel remains Hyman’s report; no new edition collation is claimed.
